note: Documentation, not behaviour. The thrust model assumes a published thrust curve is referenced to sea level; the guide now says what justifies that. NFPA 1125 requires motors be tested at, or corrected to, sea level and 20 C, and the NAR's own testing manual requires every test site to be within 500 feet of mean sea level. It stays an assumption - no curve file records where it was fired, and only about a third of the curves the app flies come from a certifying body - and the guide says that too. The reference pressure is unchanged.
